name: manual_95f44d
claim: The planned v2 Orchestrator Controller owns job claims and leases as an internal Oramasys boot module; a standalone repository is possible only through its admission gate. The top orchestrator is a capability-bearing client, not the state writer; spawn order grants no authority. PT remains the v1 owner; handoffs retain lineage, and Phylax admission remains separate. Oramasys already implements execution run-lease fencing.

decisions.notes: Preserve the separation, lineage and capability constraints while correcting the absolute standalone-repository claim and distinguishing existing run leases from planned job-claim leases under doc 68 section 9.

rationale: Preserve the separation, lineage and capability constraints while correcting the absolute standalone-repository claim and distinguishing existing run leases from planned job-claim leases under doc 68 section 9.
